Technical SEO.title: Google Says Technical SEO Remains Key For AI SEO
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller cautioned against relying on short-term AI SEO tactics, affirming that traditional technical SEO remains relevant in the AI search era. This is a direct signal from Google that enterprise technical foundations should not be deprioritized in favor of AI-specific shortcuts.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google tells advertisers AI search queries now run 3x longer
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google has communicated to advertisers that AI-driven search queries are now significantly longer than traditional queries, running approximately three times the length. This shift has direct implications for organic keyword strategy and content targeting in AI search environments.

AI Search / GEO.title: Over 80% Of Google Searches Have AI Overviews and Growing
AI Search / GEO.summary: More than 80% of Google searches now surface AI Overviews, and that share continues to grow, according to this report. For enterprise and travel SEO teams, this signals that AI Overview visibility is rapidly becoming a baseline requirement rather than an emerging consideration.

AI Search / GEO.title: Rank Data Skews, AIOs Hit 97% of Buyer Queries: DesignRush SEO Roundup
AI Search / GEO.summary: This roundup reports that AI Overviews are appearing on 97% of buyer-intent queries, while also flagging concerns about skewed rank-tracking data from Ahrefs. Both findings are directly actionable for enterprise SEO teams managing conversion-stage content and reporting accuracy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: This data study maps which domains are most frequently cited as sources across major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI. Understanding citation patterns across these engines is a core input for building a GEO strategy for enterprise brands.

AI Search / GEO.title: How LLMs Choose Sources to Cite: What the Data Actually Shows
AI Search / GEO.summary: This piece examines the data behind how large language models select which sources to cite in their responses, offering insight into the factors that drive AI citation eligibility. For GEO practitioners, understanding LLM source-selection behavior is foundational to content and authority strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: GEO news, analysis, and trends - Search Engine Land
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land maintains a dedicated library of news, analysis, and trend coverage focused on generative engine optimization. This serves as a reliable ongoing reference for enterprise SEO and GEO practitioners tracking the evolving discipline.
